DESCRIPTION:Cornell University Library’s Division of Rare and Manuscript 
 Collections commemorates the 250th anniversary of the American Declaration
  of Independence (1776–2026) with an exhibition of rare books\, letters\
 , and documents on the life of George Washington.\n\nThese highlights of t
 he collection reflect the interests of Cornell’s first president\, Andre
 w Dickson White\, who had a fascination with both American history and boo
 k collecting. The acquisition of rare materials relating to Washington and
  his era formed an integral part of White’s educational vision. Despite 
 subsequent transformations in the discipline\, White’s principle remains
  resonant: collecting\, displaying\, and teaching with rare books\, autogr
 aphs\, signatures\, and portraits make history tangible and alive.
